journal_lines: Heard it before I saw it. Put it down.
Shambling thing in the corridor. Gone.
Smelled it first. Dealt with it.
Three in the low ground. Came at them from above.
Armor on this one. Took longer.
Didn't smell it coming. Unusual. Noted.
Moved it out of the path and continued.
Some in a group. Worked through them.
Waterlogged one on the path. The mud slowed it further.
Chickens following behind it. Ignored the chickens.
Hit from behind. Turned around. Finished it.
